commands.afterRunInfo: What to do with the text the command returns. “Show action menu” opens the menu on it. “Replace the selection” puts it over the selected text the command got; when the text came from elsewhere, the menu opens instead. “Copy” puts it into the clipboard. For a script the output is stdout, waited for up to 60 s; with “Nothing”, a script still running after 3 s is left in the background. For a webhook it is the “text” field of a JSON answer or the whole body.

settings.actionCommandNoTextInfo: Runs in the system shell (sh, zsh or PowerShell). The command takes no text.
settings.actionLogOutputInfo: Writes the output to actions.log in the app log folder (Settings → Storage → Logs). Failures are always logged. The text itself is not logged.
settings.actionWebhookAuthInfo: The Authorization header, e.g. “Bearer …”. It is kept in the secure store and sent only to the webhook’s address.
settings.actionWebhookAuthReplacePlaceholder: Saved. Enter a new value to replace it
settings.actionWebhookBodyInfo: {placeholder} is replaced with the text escaped for JSON: inside a string, as in "{placeholder}", or bare, which gives a JSON string. A body that is not JSON is sent as text/plain.

settings.actionWebhookUrlInfo: {placeholder} in the URL is replaced with the URL-encoded text. Without it, a GET request sends the text as the “text” parameter.

settings.translationGlossaryInfo:
Translation rules (one entry per line):

• Source = Translation — always translate the specified word or phrase using this exact wording.
Example: workspace = workspace

• !Term — do not translate the word or phrase (keep as is in the entire text).
Example: !TyCo
(An exclamation mark at the start of the line protects the entire phrase after it).
settings.translationProviderHint: Primary service or model for the first translation pass.
settings.translationQualityInfo:
Determines when an AI model performs a second pass to check and polish the translation:
• Off — translate without a second pass or repairs.
• Repair detected problems — the AI model corrects the translation only if issues are found.
• Always perform a second pass — always polishes the translation.

The second pass is primarily useful for AI model (LLM) translations rather than Google or DeepL.
settings.translationsHint: Target languages for translation. Each one gets a hotkey in the translation menu.
settings.windowInsertionHint: The program that presses keys in another app: xdotool works on X11, ydotool on Wayland. The field below holds its path.
